evidence_type: unmodified x86 actor presentation/death blocks with actual supplied MASTER sequence lengths

findings.behavior: Four blocked neighboring floor/bomb queries activate one of13 corner sequences using sharedrand%13, retaining the old fractional special clock. Reopening a neighboring route clears onlyspecial, preservingframe/remainder.

Stand/walk uses movement intent; carrying selects standbomb/walkbomb. Standing stun displays oldspecialframe&3 direction. Original selected frame is captured before advancing; action counters use signed16 remainder and unsigned16 frame wrapping.

All24 death sequence lengths match supplied assets. Deaths always use storedbase/team palette, bypassing initial player-color reveal. Angelrise preserves prior motion remainder, captures oldposition, and can finish belowY=-20 before incrementingdeathframe.

Death power release executes before frame25 speechchance. Speechchance isresource95=5 and is checked afterframeadvance, so repeated updates onframe25 consume repeated shared draws even though suppliedsound700is absent.

limitations: Presentation/death block parity does not establish whole Windows application equivalence.
Transit and movement are checked by their own native component and complete battle-engine comparisons.
The queue records original selected sequence/frame/palette/position; actual raster output has a separate frontend comparison.
